image_asset_coverage.formula_verified: Images with verified provenance (43) / Total images scanned (63) * 100
image_asset_coverage.formula_incomplete: Images with incomplete provenance (10) / Total images scanned (63) * 100
image_asset_coverage.formula_flagged: Images flagged for review (10) / Total images scanned (63) * 100

video_media_coverage.formula_verified: Files with verified licensing (0) / Total media files scanned (2) * 100
video_media_coverage.formula_uncertain: Files with uncertain provenance (2) / Total media files scanned (2) * 100
video_media_coverage.formula_flagged: Files with potential matches / flagged (2) / Total media files scanned (2) * 100

text_similarity_and_plagiarism.formula_originality: (Total passages analyzed (200) - Significant external matches (0)) / Total analyzed (200) * 100
text_similarity_and_plagiarism.formula_attribution: Passages with verified attribution (48) / Total analyzed (200) * 100
text_similarity_and_plagiarism.formula_review: Passages requiring legal/editorial review (5) / Total analyzed (200) * 100

code_and_dependency_licensing.formula_identification: Dependencies with identified licenses (20) / Total production dependencies (20) * 100
code_and_dependency_licensing.formula_attribution_obligations: Dependencies with Section 4 attribution obligations (2) / Total dependencies (20) * 100
